title: Typography
example:
import { Typography } from 'moru-ui'

export function ProjectIntroduction() {
  return (
    <section>
      <Typography variant="heading" as="h2">
        A thoughtful workspace
      </Typography>
      <Typography variant="body">Start with the essentials and make it your own.</Typography>
      <Typography variant="caption" as="p">
        Updated today
      </Typography>
    </section>
  )
}
api:
type TypographyElement =
  | 'h1'
  | 'h2'
  | 'h3'
  | 'h4'
  | 'h5'
  | 'h6'
  | 'p'
  | 'span'
  | 'div'
  | 'label'
  | 'strong'
  | 'small'
  | 'code'

type TypographyProps = HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> & {
  variant?: TypographyRole
  as?: TypographyElement
}

function Typography({
  variant = 'body',
  as,
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: TypographyProps);
